item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00379","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C16","C11","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C16","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C16 is the strongest plausible drafting template because it is an earlier letter transmitting supplemental military appropriations to the Speaker and combines the same formal transmittal structure with the substantive proposition that expanded military strength must be sustained by economic and productive capacity. The child substantially enlarges and adapts that framework from domestic military requirements to mutual-defense assistance abroad. C11 has related national-security appropriations machinery and a categorized allocation discussion, while C07 supplies an especially close but largely conventional supplemental-estimate letter frame. C16's combination of shared form, subject, and economic-defense reasoning makes the relationship material rather than merely boilerplate.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress a supplemental estimate of appropriation for the fiscal year 1951 of $4,000,000,000 to provide military assistance to foreign nations.","parent_excerpt":"I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress supplemental estimates of appropriation in the amount of $2,434,441,000 for the fiscal year 1949 for the National Military Establishment","explanation":"Both open as formal letters to the Speaker transmitting a specified supplemental military appropriation for a stated fiscal year."},{"child_excerpt":"In intensifying our efforts and the efforts of those joined with us to increase our common defensive power, we must not lose sight of the fact that military power rests on economic strength.","parent_excerpt":"Military strength is dependent on a strong economic system and a strong industrial and productive capacity","explanation":"The child closely reuses the earlier directive's substantive linkage between military strength and the economic and productive base needed to sustain it."},{"child_excerpt":"The details of the appropriation estimate are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith.","parent_excerpt":"The details of these estimates, the necessity therefor, and the reasons for their submission at this time are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith","explanation":"The letters conclude the recommendation through the same accompanying Budget Director letter mechanism and nearly identical language."}]}
